name.value: Delta Hotels by Marriott Vancouver Delta

description.value: Delta Hotels by Marriott is a 4-star hotel with 124 rooms in Delta, BC, offering non-smoking accommodation with free Wi-Fi. A mainstream chain hotel providing reliable lodging for touring cyclists passing through the region. Specific bike storage and handling procedures are not documented in available sources.
